[quote=corzerran;61261957][i]Thank you.[/i] Kain followed Veronika through the halls until they reached the meeting room Queen Elena sat in. When she entered, she bowed, making her way over to her.

[i]Queen Elena, its nice to speak with you. I hope all is going well in Koranvistan, and that things will only get better.[/i] She extended her hand for a formal handshake[/quote]
She returned the handshake and smiled, [i]"Many thanks, it's a pleasure. The Kingdom has been in better straits, but it should be a matter of the past. Now,"[/i] She took a step back and gestured to the table, [i]"Would you like something to drink while we discuss?"[/i]

Back to Business: 14 December, 2027

The Assembly made great strides in the first few months, amending errors and writing wrongs from the HoCs tenure. Some HoC representatives were found to have directed treasury funds to shell non-profits in embezzlement schemes. Sergei Azemocyk, former representative from Kyraniya, pled guilty to charges of fraud, but claimed he had been on the wrong end of some bad people. He gave the court a list of names and walked.
The Royal Department of Investigation connected the names to the infamous Sasanov Syndicate, whom they already had an extensive case on. The Assembly had already approved larger budgets for the RDI and the 3 regional narcotics agencies, and the first phase (mass training) was almost finished.
The Kingdom was enjoying the benefits of EDU membership and the new trade corridor Greater economic activity, a steadily growing middle class, and more options opening up for those in need. Unfortunately, the new business gave the Syndicate and other traffickers more places to hide. The Assembly increased security and scrutiny at the ports, and hired from paramilitary groups to assist in Syndicate busts.
Azemocyks Rat List kickstarted Phase II of the attack on the Syndicate: Undercover KDI agents, mapping the Syndicates network and identifying where to bust to do maximum damage. The KDI managed to uncover four distinct areas of operation: Sasanov and Chevets areas in the north, the Tsorovik area in the west, and the Kabalev area in the south. The Kabalev bloc is how the biggest supplies come in: over national borders, in trucks and vans. The Tsorovik bloc is the way product leaves, on to the next place in the pipeline.

Dandy, Squidge, and Padlock sat around the table in the smoky room. The fourth there, Draco, was the boss. He sat, crouched in the chair with a lit smoke in his mouth, a loose red tie, and black from head to toe. [i]KDs pokin around, eh?[/i]
Dandy cleared his throat, [i]Yeah. Weve taken out three undercovers in the past week. Word is the Assembly wants to keep going till were done.[/i]
[i]Bah. Done. The Syndicate is older than the Monarchy, older than their revolution.[/i] He stubbed out his smoke on the table. [i]If they get too nosy, we can get them out of the way.[/i]
He stood out of his chair and looked to the three, [i]I need to call a good friend, Eida. Get out.[/i]
